name: Island
description: Your workspace as islands, with a town that grows as your agents work.
author: Hivemind

settings.label: Light
settings.description: By the clock, windows light up at dusk and the stars come out at night.

settings.label: Motion
labels: Less: no flights, walking, smoke or waves

settings.label: Frames a second
settings.description: Fewer frames use less of the computer. It draws nothing while hidden.

settings.label: Shadows
settings.description: Turned off on their own above 60 agents.

settings.label: Camera effects
settings.description: The model-town focus and the glow of lit windows.

commands.name: census
commands.description: How many islands and agents there are, how many are working, calling the person, idle or stopped, who is calling, how many turns they finished today, and how many lots stand empty, laid, framed and finished.

commands.name: next
commands.description: Fly to the agent calling the person longest and open its live terminal beside the islands.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Fly to the agent whose name holds this text and open its live terminal.

commands.name: overview
commands.description: Pull back to see every island.

commands.name: island
commands.description: Fly to the island whose name holds this text; says how many agents work there and how many turns they finished today.
